mapper.select: SELECT grade_code, grade_name, base_salary, description, sort_no FROM salary_grade ORDER BY sort_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_salary (employee_id, allowance, bonus_ratio) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{allowance}, #{bonusRatio})
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, month, base_salary, allowance, performance_bonus, red_packet, total, created_at FROM salary_monthly WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND month >= #{fromMonth} ORDER BY month
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_monthly (employee_id, month, base_salary, allowance, performance_bonus, red_packet, total) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{month}, #{baseSalary}, #{allowance}, #{performanceBonus}, #{redPacket}, #{total})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.employee_id, a.type, a.old_value, a.new_value, a.reason, o.name AS operator_name, a.created_at FROM salary_adjustment a JOIN employee o ON o.id = a.operator_id WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_adjustment (employee_id, type, old_value, new_value, reason, operator_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{type}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
